title: Maple Days: Moving, Talking & Daily Rhythm
brands: Everyday learning for Maple at 8 months: cup sips, reading, talking, two languages, pulling up and climbing, copying games, walks, daily rhythm and baby-proofing
Household help for Max, Nozomi and Maple. Fresh picks only: nothing repeats an earlier Household deck or the board's Jakarta trip cards.
